log: A celebrating city that falls into civil disorder now keeps its celebration, as in Civ1. While the disorder lasts its squares keep the celebration's bonus, and when order returns it carries on celebrating without a new announcement, growing at once under a Republic or Democracy (civ-clone/web-renderer#1013).
When a city's disorder brings down a Democracy, cities that had already celebrated that turn still grow, as in Civ1 (civ-clone/web-renderer#1013).
